note: Ceilings for tests/test_fleet_trial.py, per role and in total: tool_calls counts every MCP tool call the scripted agent makes in one run of the conductor recipe, bytes_received the UTF-8 bytes of the text content of every answer, single_acks the calls that acknowledge one notification. All are the measured values, identical over five runs, with no headroom. A requirement that removes calls lowers them in the same commit; raise one only with a stated reason in the same PR. The reviewer's scratch run against a live demo (2026-11-22) counted the same 142 calls and 39 acknowledgements and 382,369 bytes: its longer ids and names, and put-down drains that re-read each seat's feed from its first cursor, account for the difference. F2 lowered bytes_received by 1,177 (from 359,252): the desk's ready-lane and not_offered meanings were shortened when they gained the review-request answer, and each desk read carries 107 fewer characters. C5 raised bytes_received by 440 (conductor 160, review 280): every review request row now carries reported_verdict and fulfillment_event_id. C6 raised bytes_received by 708 (conductor 149, design 150, build 205, review 204) with the same 142 calls and 39 acknowledgements: each my_desk answer's office carries `fence` with the comparison basis only, +627 over 11 desk reads (the leases lane's meaning text is 7 characters shorter); the builder's lease, its claimed and renewed events and their notification say path_fence `lexical, root unknown` where they said `unresolved` (+99); and the work context's how_to_claim text is shorter, -18 over 14 reads net of the builder's lease in it. F12 lowered bytes_received by 105,650 (29.4%, from 359,223) with the same 142 calls and 39 acknowledgements: every answer's text is sent as compact JSON instead of indented JSON (conductor -40,729 from 137,236; design -16,008 from 59,870; build -18,709 from 65,330; review -30,204 from 96,787). It is whitespace alone: each role's answers rendered as dd594b1 sent them total exactly the old ceilings, so no answer in this recipe is cut differently.
